-- Server owns the blade parts (so later hit detection / upgrades live here).
-- The orbit motion itself is animated per-client; see client/BladeOrbit.client.lua.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Config = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config).Blades

local root = Instance.new("Folder")
root.Name = "Blades"
root.Parent = workspace

local function makeBlade(index: number): Part
	local blade = Instance.new("Part")
	blade.Name = "Blade" .. index
	blade.Size = Config.Size
	blade.Color = Config.Color
	blade.Material = Config.Material
	blade.Anchored = true
	blade.CanCollide = false
	blade.CanQuery = false
	blade.CanTouch = true
	blade.CastShadow = false
	blade:SetAttribute("Index", index)

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Config.Color
	light.Brightness = Config.LightBrightness
	light.Range = Config.LightRange
	light.Parent = blade

	local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -Config.Size.Z / 2)
	a0.Parent = blade
	local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, Config.Size.Z / 2)
	a1.Parent = blade

	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Attachment0 = a0
	trail.Attachment1 = a1
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Config.Color, Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255))
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 1)
	trail.Lifetime = Config.TrailLifetime
	trail.LightEmission = 1
	trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(Config.TrailWidth)
	trail.FaceCamera = true
	trail.Parent = blade

	return blade
end

local function setBladeCount(player: Player, count: number)
	local folder = root:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId))
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = tostring(player.UserId)
		folder.Parent = root
	end
	folder:ClearAllChildren()
	for i = 1, count do
		makeBlade(i).Parent = folder
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	setBladeCount(player, Config.StartCount)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local folder = root:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId))
	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
	end
end)

for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	setBladeCount(player, Config.StartCount)
end
EOF
cat > src/client/BladeOrbit.client.lua <<'EOF'
-- Moves every player's blades locally each frame. Blade phase derives from the
-- synced server clock, so all clients (and the server) agree on positions.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config).Blades

local bladesRoot = workspace:WaitForChild("Blades")

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local t = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for _, folder in bladesRoot:GetChildren() do
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(folder.Name) or 0)
		local hrp = player and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then
			continue
		end

		local blades = folder:GetChildren()
		local count = #blades
		for _, blade in blades do
			local i = blade:GetAttribute("Index")
			if not i then
				continue
			end
			local angle = t * Config.OrbitSpeed + (i - 1) * (2 * math.pi / count)
			local bob = math.sin(t * Config.BobSpeed + i) * Config.BobAmount
			local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * Config.OrbitRadius, Config.Height + bob, math.sin(angle) * Config.OrbitRadius)
			local pos = hrp.Position + offset
			local tangent = Vector3.new(-math.sin(angle), 0, math.cos(angle))
			blade.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + tangent) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, t * Config.SpinSpeed + i)
		end
	end
end)
EOF

content.text:
Each player now gets 2 neon-cyan blades orbiting at 7 studs. I haven't built or run any of it: my `rojo build` check was blocked, so the Luau is untested.

- **`src/shared/Config.lua`**: holds every tunable number: 2 starting blades, radius 7, orbit speed, spin speed, bob, blade size, cyan colour, glow and trail settings.
- **`src/shared/Remotes.lua`**: the one place RemoteEvents are declared. You add a name to its `EVENT_NAMES` list and it creates the events on the server and fetches them on the client. The list is empty because this first piece doesn't need any remotes.
- **`src/server/Blades.server.lua`**: creates the blade parts for each player under `Workspace.Blades/<UserId>/`. It's written so you can change the blade count later (for upgrades). It cleans up when a player leaves.
- **`src/client/BladeOrbit.client.lua`**: moves every player's blades each frame, so the motion is smooth for everyone. Position comes from the synced server clock, so all clients agree on where the blades are.

For the look, each blade is a neon part with a cyan point light and a cyan-to-blue trail. It rolls along its length as it orbits, and it bobs up and down slightly.

I also deleted the three `.gitkeep` files, since those folders now have real files in them. Nothing is committed.

To try it, run `rojo build -o game.rbxlx`, or `rojo serve` and connect from Studio.

The server never moves the blades, so a kill check on the server will have to work out blade positions with the same formula the client uses. I'd put that formula in shared code when we reach kills.

-- Server owns the blade parts (so later hit detection / upgrades live here).
-- The orbit motion itself is animated per-client; see client/BladeOrbit.client.lua.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Config = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config).Blades

local root = Instance.new("Folder")
root.Name = "Blades"
root.Parent = workspace

local function makeBlade(index: number): Part
	local blade = Instance.new("Part")
	blade.Name = "Blade" .. index
	blade.Size = Config.Size
	blade.Color = Config.Color
	blade.Material = Config.Material
	blade.Anchored = true
	blade.CanCollide = false
	blade.CanQuery = false
	blade.CanTouch = true
	blade.CastShadow = false
	blade:SetAttribute("Index", index)

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Config.Color
	light.Brightness = Config.LightBrightness
	light.Range = Config.LightRange
	light.Parent = blade

	local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -Config.Size.Z / 2)
	a0.Parent = blade
	local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, Config.Size.Z / 2)
	a1.Parent = blade

	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Attachment0 = a0
	trail.Attachment1 = a1
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Config.Color, Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255))
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 1)
	trail.Lifetime = Config.TrailLifetime
	trail.LightEmission = 1
	trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(Config.TrailWidth)
	trail.FaceCamera = true
	trail.Parent = blade

	return blade
end

local function setBladeCount(player: Player, count: number)
	local folder = root:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId))
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = tostring(player.UserId)
		folder.Parent = root
	end
	folder:ClearAllChildren()
	for i = 1, count do
		makeBlade(i).Parent = folder
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	setBladeCount(player, Config.StartCount)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local folder = root:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId))
	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
	end
end)

for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	setBladeCount(player, Config.StartCount)
end
EOF
